newsitem.title: UK: Latin America sugar freight demand continues apace.
newsitem.headline: Latin America sugar freight demand continues apace.

text.p: Fixtures were thin on the ground on the sugar freight market at the start of the week but new business continued to flow from Latin American origins, shipbrokers said on Monday.
E D & F Man quoted for 14,000 tonnes min/max bagged sugar from Coatzcoalcos or Veracruz to Algeria for prompt dates.

Shipbrokers said Kerry Trading entered the market with two new orders for bagged sugar. It was open for 6/7,000 tonnes from Thailand to Indonesia for 17/20 January and 13/14,000 tonnes form Puerto Quetzal to Colombo or Red Sea for end-January.
Iraq continued to feature in the list of new business as Glencore quoted for 14,000 tonnes from Brazil to Umm Qasr for 1/10 February.
Alpine was in the market for 25,000 tonnes in bulk from Cuba to the Black Sea for the same dates, market sources said.
